newsitem.title: THAILAND: Siam Syntech to sell stake in Malaysian firm.
newsitem.headline: Siam Syntech to sell stake in Malaysian firm.

text.p: Siam Syntech Construction Plc said on Thursday it signed an option agreement to sell an 11.89 percent equity stake in Plantation and Development (Malaysia) Bhd for 133 million Malaysian ringgit.

Under the agreement, Malaysia's Pasifik Pelana Sdn Bhd will have the right to buy shares in Plantation and Development by August 10, 1999, Siam Syntech said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
Siam Syntech also plans to issue 15.63 million new shares to existing shareholders through a two-for-one rights issue at 20 baht each, it said.
The proceeds from the capital increase would be used to finance its new construction projects and to pay off existing high-interest loans, the company said.
